issues.on_page: Capital improvement 1,553,540; p4 shows the Capital Improvement fund's only receipt is Taxes 1,553,540
issues.issue: The report shows what this fund total is: all of it is Taxes (p4, same amount). The category should be taxes (unlabeled) / taxes (unlabeled), not other / miscellaneous revenue.

issues.on_page: Other 11,700; p4 Other Governmental Funds column: Sale of supplies/property 11,700 (its only receipt)
issues.issue: The report shows what this is: sale of supplies/property. The category should be sale of assets / sale of assets.

issues.on_page: HUD 98,739; p4 HUD column: Intergovernmental 96,015 + Rent/leases 1,624 + Charges for services 1,100
issues.issue: Mostly intergovernmental (97%). Under the mixed-line rule this would be intergovernmental/state aid (other state aid or federal grants) with review.

issues.on_page: General 4,358,942 = p4 General total receipts 4,293,161 + Interest/dividends 65,781; largest parts are Taxes 1,903,934 and Intergovernmental 1,685,611
issues.issue: Mixed fund total. Under the mixed-line rule the dominant part is taxes (unlabeled), not other.

issues.on_page: Electric 23,181,004 = p6 Electric charges 7,630,953 + interest 474,785 + Miscellaneous/merchandise sales/grants 15,075,266
issues.issue: Electric charges are only 33% of this line; grants are 65%. Under the dominant-category rule the category is doubtful (the review note already mentions the grants).

issues.on_page: Miscellaneous/ merchandise sales/ grants 15,172,847 (p2: business-type capital grants and contributions 15,049,481; p7: Proceeds from grants 15,172,847)
issues.issue: About 99% of this line is grants (capital grants per p2), so the dominant category is grants and not other. The page doesn't say whether they are federal or state, so the line is kept in review. It is 52% of business-type receipts. The capital grants could also be treated as business_type.other_financing (capital contributions).
